name: Spaceship 49a92bbe on the 2-uniform tiling k2-014
description: A period-4 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-014 (touching neighbours), 5 to 6 cells, moving two lattice steps every 4 generations (c/2). It runs the same way in the 16,384 rules from B3/S2 to B3,7,8,9,10,11,12/S2,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k3-051. Its live cells also evolve the same way on k3-014 and k3-020, where the empty tiles around them have other neighbour counts. The range of rules depends on the tiling: 16,384 rules on k2-014 and k3-051; 4,096 rules on k3-014 and k3-020. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 179 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
